description: Agent Triage: submit the queue items with their assessments and the priority set on each: each item with its id, its severity and its impact (critical, high, medium or low: how serious it is and how many people or how much work it reaches), the priority level set on it, 1 handled first, and the recorded reason when the priority departs from the assessments. The signed report gives every item with its assessments, its priority and its status as consistent, overridden, inverted, inconsistent, unassessed or unranked, every pair of items where one that outranks the other on both assessments waits behind it, with whether a reason is recorded, and counts the items ranked and assessed, the inversions and the overrides, and names a priority order that runs against the assessments: an item at least as severe and as wide in impact as another, and more on one of them, that waits behind it with no recorded reason; then items with the same assessments on different priorities, priorities set with no assessment behind them and assessed items left unranked, with the fix for each. This reads the handling order of a triage queue before any promise exists: running agents triaged in priority order from a status snapshot are wever_agent-attention-brief, queue observations turned into an operator brief are wever_agent-daily-operator-brief, and open commitments read against deadlines and capacity are wever_commitment-deadline-check. Verdict priority_arbitrary, priority_partial, priority_unranked or priority_consistent. POST /api/triage-priority-check. Reads only the recorded queue items and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no item is captured, ranked, routed, escalated or closed and no queue is changed. Agent Triage reads how an agent sorts incoming work, from the item captured at intake to the disposition it ends with: it is not multi-agent coordination (how a group of agents organizes shared work, with its own escalation path, the wever_coordination checks; triage escalation is a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached), not the promises an agent has made (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; triage decides handling order and routing before any promise exists), not delegation (handing work off with authority, the wever_delegation checks; triage assigns incoming items to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the triage checks read a queue of items over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-triage-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-triage/.

items.description: Each queue item with its assessments and the priority set on it.

reason.description: The recorded reason when the priority departs from the assessments.

severity.description: The severity assessed: critical, high, medium or low.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
